goal: Secret scanning gate: keys and tokens caught before they reach the repository.
use: Secret scanning gate: keys and tokens caught before they reach the repository. Use when a commit or push may contain credentials.

steps.note: Confirm the scan runs before the push, locally and again in the pipeline.
Set the rule. Any detected live secret blocks the merge.
Check history. Scan the existing history for secrets already committed.
Check the response. A found secret must be rotated, not only removed.
Report. The rule, the detections, the rotation status and any gap.
